2026_03_LA_DEN.headline: Stafford’s passing game meets Denver’s secondary at altitude
2026_03_LA_DEN.paragraph1: Los Angeles heads to Denver with Matthew Stafford coming off a sharp Week 2 performance, but the Rams will be without Myles Garrett and could also be missing Puka Nacua. Denver counters with Bo Nix, Jaylen Waddle and a secondary led by Patrick Surtain II, while J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey returned to full practice Thursday. The matchup turns on whether the Broncos can pressure Stafford without surrendering explosives and whether Nix can keep Denver ahead of obvious passing downs.
2026_03_LA_DEN.model_rationale: Los Angeles brings the more explosive passing structure, while Denver’s path depends on disciplined coverage, efficient early downs and keeping its offense out of predictable dropback situations.
